narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an investigative commentary on the lack of transparency regarding the source of transplanted organs in China. It highlights the specific case of expert Zheng Shusen, whose published research was retracted by international journals due to ethical concerns and his inability to provide verified donor data when questioned.
